description: Generate a solver-ready FERS model JSON for a 2-D rectangular portal frame (columns + beams). Returns model JSON to pass to solve_model. Units: metres, kN, kN/m. Columns are turned 90° so their depth (column_height_mm) resists sway in the frame plane. Load combinations as create_beam: 1 'SLS characteristic (auto)' at 1.0, 2 'ULS (auto)' at 1.35. Free.

lateral_kn.description: Horizontal point load at the top-left corner, kN (default 0)

material.description: steel_S355 (default), steel_S235, steel_S275, steel_S460, aluminium_6061 or concrete_C30

roof_udl_kn_per_m.description: Gravity UDL on the top-storey beams, kN/m (default 10)

name: create_frame
title: Build a portal frame
